capture_note: Capture HEAD plus each content hash identifies working/untracked scripts, not the engine that produced every historical result. Historical engine identities remain in original result metadata and archive catalog.
scope: Remaining performance/comparison campaigns, experiment tests and statically imported local script helpers. No Brian2/brian2_rust package or Rust engine library is copied.
validation: All file hashes checked, all Python syntax parsed, no high-confidence credential patterns found. Experiments were not rerun.
execution_status: Historical paths and explicit archived engine selection require adaptation; new pinned Atlas reproduction is separate.
